name: openai-image
description: Preview-first OpenAI image generation (gpt-image-2): generate, edit with references or a mask, multi-turn via the Responses API. Every paid call previews its model, size, quality, estimated cost and output paths, runs only with --yes, writes only inside --out, leaves an audit line per image, and stops and asks the operator once real 24h spend would pass $50
hits: OpenAI Images API + Responses API (paid, the operator's own key)
surface: CLI only. `models` is free. `generate`/`edit`/`responses` preview (model, size, quality, n, estimated cost, output files) and exit 0; `--yes` runs the paid call; output is contained in `--out`, never overwritten; n <= 4 and an estimated $2.00 per call are code constants; an audit line per image on stderr and in ~/.local/share/openai-image/audit.log; a 24h hard ask: when real spend (audit-log tokens at TOKEN_RATES) over the last 24h plus this call would pass $50 (+ human allowances), --yes stops with exit 3 and the caller asks the operator; after they acknowledge an amount, `oimg allow --usd N --note "<their words>" --yes` raises the line for 24h; `spend` reports real spend for free

origin.note: Vendored lib/ and docs/ + README only. Left behind on purpose: the one-off gen-*.js / lancer-*.js / s8-*.js render scripts (both the tracked gen-condo-*.js, gen-laurelhurst-pride.js, lancer-heat-cards.js and the ~20 untracked ones), examples/ (ungated paid calls; the CLI covers each pattern), .env.example (the belt reads the key from env or a 600-mode key file, never an in-tree .env), refs/ and output/ (project assets). The source tree was dirty at copy time; every uncommitted file was a one-off script, refs/ or .claude/, so nothing uncommitted was hand-copied. Model, pricing and parameter facts were updated to the 2026-08-22 brief in docs/openai-image-best-practices.md; constants.js, gpt-image.js and the oimg CLI are this belt's.

install.description: Install the openai SDK locally from the committed lockfile
install.why: lib/gpt-image.js imports it; nothing is installed globally
install.yes: node_modules/ is created inside tools/openai-image; no call to OpenAI is made
install.no: skipped; every oimg verb fails on import until you run it

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Your own OpenAI API key from an organization that has completed API verification (gpt-image-* models 403 otherwise). Alternative: ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key, mode 600. Not needed for `models` or for any preview

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_HOME
env.description: Where audit.log lives. Default ~/.local/share/openai-image. Tests point it at a temp dir

auth.flow: A personal OpenAI API key, from $OPENAI_API_KEY or a 600-mode key file; the key is read by lib/gpt-image.js resolveKey(), sent only in the Authorization header by the openai SDK, and never printed, logged, or placed on argv
auth.login: Create a key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys in a verified organization, then: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt && umask 077 && printf '%s\n' 'sk-…' > ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; resolveKey() refuses a group/world-readable one. $OPENAI_API_KEY takes precedence when set
caches.revoke: Delete the key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys, then rm ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key

safeguards: Preview by default: generate, edit and responses print the model, size, quality, n, the estimated cost and its basis, the input files, and every output path, then exit 0 without a network call; only --yes runs it (oimg.mjs main(), renderPreview()) — the flag tier for paid-but-private spend (SENSIBILITIES #2, #5)
--yes is always honored: this is the operator's own money on a private surface, so the gate prevents the accidental call and never refuses the deliberate one (SENSIBILITIES #2)

Two ceilings are code constants in oimg.mjs that no flag raises: MAX_N = 4 images per call (the API allows 10) and MAX_EST_USD = 2.00 estimated spend per call; a request above either is refused with exit 2 naming the constant (SENSIBILITIES #3)

The 24h HARD ASK (HARD_ASK_USD = 50 in oimg.mjs, lib/spend.js): before any paid call, real spend over the rolling last 24 hours (audit-log tokens_out/tokens_in at TOKEN_RATES; est_usd only where tokens are missing) plus this call's estimate is compared with $50 plus human allowances from the last 24h; over it, --yes stops with exit 3 and tells the caller to ask the operator. The gate counts the total because many cheap calls are how money actually goes (2026-10-05: 513 renders, each under the $2 per-call ceiling, ≈$100)

`oimg allow` is the hard ask's door, in the flag tier at Rob's direction (an acknowledgment in conversation, not a terminal ritual): it previews without --yes, requires --usd N (max MAX_ALLOW_USD = 500) and --note with the operator's acknowledgment in their words, and appends {at, usd, note} to ~/.local/share/openai-image/allowances.log (600); allowances expire after 24h. The code cannot tell who wrote the note — CLAUDE.md is the contract: only the operator's own yes to that amount counts (SENSIBILITIES #2)

Containment: --out <dir> is required, every file is written inside it (planOutputs() resolves and asserts the parent), --name is restricted to [A-Za-z0-9._-], the filesystem root and the home directory are refused as --out, and an existing file is never overwritten (refuseExisting() before the call, O_EXCL on write)

Size is validated against the gpt-image-2 constraints before any call (parseSize(): edges x16, <= 3840px, ratio <= 3:1, pixel bounds) and sizes above 2560x1440 are labelled experimental in the preview

Audit line per image written, on stderr and appended to ~/.local/share/openai-image/audit.log (dir 700, file 600): timestamp, verb, model, size, quality, estimated USD, file, bytes from a re-stat of the written file, token usage, response id — never the key, never the prompt text beyond the preview (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Estimates are honest about their basis: preset sizes use per-image prices — gpt-image-2's calibrated from observed token usage (7,024 out at 1024² high ≈ $0.211), since the page-derived figures were ~5x low, custom sizes are scaled by pixel count and say so, quality auto is priced as high, edits and responses name what the estimate omits (input-image tokens; the mainline model's text tokens)

The key comes from $OPENAI_API_KEY or ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key only; a group/world-readable key file is refused; there is no in-tree .env and dotenv is not a dependency; the preview reports only whether a credential was found and from where (SENSIBILITIES #11)
180s request timeout; moderation_blocked, 429 and 403 (unverified organization) each get a plain message and exit 1 with no retry (SENSIBILITIES #8)
The tiers are a table in the code (VERBS in oimg.mjs) and the test suite asserts this manifest's verbs[] matches it

verbs.name: models
verbs.note: model ids, per-image prices, token rates and rate-limit tiers from constants.js; no network

verbs.name: spend
verbs.note: real spend over the last 24h from audit-log token counts at TOKEN_RATES, the hard-ask line and headroom; no network

verbs.name: allow
verbs.note: after the operator acknowledges $N in conversation: raises the 24h hard-ask line by N (max 500) for 24h; --note records their words; previews without --yes; never on an agent's own initiative

verbs.name: generate
verbs.note: paid, private: preview (model, size, quality, n, est cost, output paths) then --yes; n <= 4, est <= $2.00 per call are code constants; output only inside --out; audit line per image

verbs.name: edit
verbs.note: paid, private: same preview → --yes; up to 16 --image inputs and an optional alpha --mask; input_fidelity is dropped for gpt-image-2 (the API rejects it); the estimate excludes input-image tokens and says so

verbs.name: responses
verbs.note: paid, private: Responses API image_generation tool on gpt-5.6 with --previous <response-id> for multi-turn edits; one image per call; the estimate excludes the mainline model's text tokens and says so

verbs.name: variations (dall-e-2), Files API upload, batch
verbs.note: no verb exists; lib/gpt-image.js exposes stream() for callers who import it, but the CLI has no streaming verb

risk.worst_case: up to $2.00 (estimated) per --yes call, and at most $50 of real spend per rolling 24h (plus whatever the operator acknowledged) before the tool stops and asks; image files written under a directory the operator named; nothing is deleted or overwritten and nothing leaves the operator's account

checks.fix: cd {TOOLBELT}/tools/openai-image && npm ci   (or: toolbelt setup openai-image) — the CLI needs the openai SDK; the unit tests do not call it

checks.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
checks.label: OpenAI API key present (env, or a 600-mode ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key) — needed only to spend
checks.fix: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt && umask 077 && printf '%s\n' 'sk-…' > ~/.config/toolbelt/openai-image.key — from a verified organization (gpt-image-* 403 otherwise)

checks.label: api.openai.com reachable (401 without a key counts)

smoke_test.command: OPENAI_API_KEY= node oimg.mjs models >/dev/null && node oimg.mjs spend >/dev/null && OPENAI_API_KEY= node oimg.mjs generate 'smoke test' --out output --quality high | grep -q 'PREVIEW, nothing sent' && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: after npm ci: the price table renders; a paid verb previews and makes no call with no credential; unit tests green — ceilings, size constraints, estimates, containment, request builders, key-file permissions, manifest/VERBS parity

do_not_vendor: gen-*.js and other one-off render scripts
